q1 = 6833543  # March 2009
q2 = 7551862  # September 2009

print(f'Q2 (September 2009): {q2}')
print(f'Arc percent change (raw): {arc_pct}')
print(f'Arc percent change (rounded to thousandths): {round(arc_pct, 3)}')
"
